title: Fill the basket
description: Three wood balls hang in a column at x = 350 near the top right, at heights 280, 262, and 244, and fall from the start. A basket 50 cm wide and 40 cm deep stands on the floor at (60, 0.5), bottom left. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 50 to 300. Two balls have to come to rest inside the basket.
